title: Carson Aday’s ‘Without You Around’ is a haunting reflection on love’s breaking point
htmlContent:
Carson Aday’s latest single, “Without You Around,” takes listeners on an emotional journey, blending the feel of classic 90s music with deep personal reflections. Drawing inspiration from the emotional honesty of Nirvana’s “Something in the Way,” Aday creates a sound that feels personal and relatable.

The song grabs your attention with its smooth, flowing bass that reflects the ups and downs of a shaky relationship. Aday’s voice, filled with longing, feels like a quiet confession in a dark room. “Without You Around” tells the story of someone torn between the desire to break free from a toxic relationship and the fear of being alone. The struggle is real, letting go might mean relief, but it also brings uncertainty and sadness.

https://open.spotify.com/track/21SB2a2c0oQnjWWkhu9oUt?si=3MOZ0JMbRoyyulijzADctQ

Aday’s heartfelt delivery makes every line feel like a personal moment captured in music. The song mixes classic post-punk vibes with modern sounds, giving it a fresh feel. With his storytelling, Carson Aday revisits the sounds of 90s alternative music and brings them into the modern era.
